name: kb-sqlite-cpudiag-{{v}}
description: SQLite {{v}} walrace with per-CPU diagnostics on the console.

workload.run:
grep '^cpu' /proc/stat | sed "s/^/hydo-cpudiag: step $HYDO_FROM before: /" > /dev/console
/bin/walrace run /data/db/t.db $HYDO_ACKED $HYDO_OUTCOMES $HYDO_FROM $HYDO_TO &
p=$!
n=0
while [ $n -lt 200 ] && [ -d /proc/$p ]; do
  for t in /proc/$p/task/*; do
    [ -r $t/stat ] && echo "${t##*/} $(cut -d' ' -f39 $t/stat 2>/dev/null)"
  done
  n=$((n+1))
done > /tmp/cpudiag.$HYDO_FROM
wait $p
rc=$?
awk -v s=$HYDO_FROM 'NF==2 && $2!="" { n[$2]++; seen[$1" "$2]=1 }
  END { for (c in n) printf "hydo-cpudiag: step %s samples on cpu%s: %d\n", s, c, n[c];
        for (k in seen) { split(k, a, " "); cpus[a[1]] = cpus[a[1]] " " a[2] }
        both=0; tot=0; for (t in cpus) { tot++; if (cpus[t] ~ / 0/ && cpus[t] ~ / 1/) both++ }
        printf "hydo-cpudiag: step %s threads sampled: %d, seen on both cpu0 and cpu1: %d\n", s, tot, both }' \
  /tmp/cpudiag.$HYDO_FROM > /dev/console
grep '^cpu' /proc/stat | sed "s/^/hydo-cpudiag: step $HYDO_FROM after: /" > /dev/console
exit $rc

knobs.name: workload seed (writer count, transaction sizes, checkpoint modes, autocheckpoint)

invariants.msg: every committed write is present with its value and PRAGMA integrity_check is ok
